description: Find companies by name, sector or country, to get the id that `company`, `relationships` and the entity tools take. Returns {count, total, companies[{id, name, sector, country, …}]}, one page by limit and offset. Metered: see CHARGING in the server instructions; quote first with `billing_quote`.

country.description: Country as an ISO code or a name; USA, US and United States find the same companies.

fields.description: Only these keys in each row (plus id). Omit for all.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return. Up to 100. Default 50.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging. Default 0.

search.description: Part of the company's name (case-insensitive substring match), e.g. "rio tinto".

name: company_search
